principles.text: Price creator deals off average views, not followers, and keep your CPM below your revenue per thousand views.
Pay creators flat fees upfront so you keep the upside when a video goes viral; performance deals give it away.
Find the broken funnel step before buying traffic: 5 downloads per 1,000 views, 75%+ paywall rate, 10% paywall conversion.
Choose the channel by cash: UGC if you're tight on money, influencers with some budget, paid ads once cash flow isn't a concern.
The moat is distribution and execution volume, not the product: sign creators faster and get them posting more.

sampleQA.question: How much should I pay an influencer to promote my app?

answer.text: Price the deal off the creator's average views, not followers. Sponsored posts usually underperform their normal content.
Your hard cap is your RPM: never pay a CPM higher than the revenue you earn per thousand views.
Pay a flat rate upfront and cap view bonuses around 1M views, so a viral hit is upside for you.
With UGC, test cheaply first (10 videos at $10), then move winners to 30 videos a month at $30.

sampleQA.question: Should my app have a free trial, and how long?

answer.text: Only add a trial once you have proof people want the product and will pay; a trial can't fix a boring product or bad messaging.
Longer trials convert better because people forget to cancel. If you aren't paying for traffic, go long.
If you buy installs through creators, shorten it: each extra day adds noise between install and charge, and attribution decides which creators you keep.
If people won't pay right away, check for a missing wow moment, no unique mechanism, a weak pain point or wrong messaging.

sampleQA.question: My app gets views but few paying users. What's wrong?

answer.text: Know four numbers: views, App Store impressions, paywall rate and paywall conversion. Targets are 5 downloads per 1,000 views, 75%+ and 10%.
High views but weak downloads is a message or demand problem; under 5 per 1,000 means your creative and store page disagree.
Weak paywall conversion often starts in the ad, store page or onboarding. Carry one message all the way to the paywall.
Fix whichever metric is furthest off first; everything else waits.
